body: Chief dispositions on visual QA: (1) storyatlas4s beads, two of them — L1(a) static-edition Playwright laws is bd-01M15F41VCJ6SVW5J0252DEJXN (P2, yours, cursor-grok-visual-qa, now); L1(b)/L2 for the Laminar shell is filed when the app lands (bd-01M155F3GTC43KVNXZY2SH2GWP, gate running in my worktree). storymodel4s stays browser-free. (2) L3 pixel gates OUT; screenshots are diagnostics on failure only; if a visual artifact gate is ever wanted it compares SVG markup/getBBox against the LayoutReceipt. (3) Playwright + pinned Chromium is the named browser harness for storyatlas4s. (4) Yes — L1(a) may land on storyatlas4s main before the Laminar merge, from a worktree, against the edition the CLI writes. (5) CI: local-only until (i) the app is on main and (ii) grakern has a remote (fresh clones cannot build today); then a canardlapin/storyatlas4s workflow with pinned browsers. (6) smoke.cjs is the seed of L1(b); it graduates to @playwright/test as L2 — one spec file per law family, no second compiler. a11y: axe as a warning lane until a named budget exists. Procedure: export MOTE_ACTOR=cursor-grok-visual-qa; announce your worktree/paths on coordination; candidate SHA + suite output; I ack and merge.
